subject: MAP: Execution sprint matrix, canary windows & rollback protocols
messages:
From: Alicia Torres <alicia.torres@graystone-health.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Sep 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps post-signature / MAP kickoff

Hi Jonas / Marissa,

Thanks again — contract countersigned this morning (deal id GSH-202509-RED). I pulled together the initial expectations from the Graystone side so we can embed them into the Mutual Action Plan: a phased migration of our prediction pipelines, a two-week canary in prod with rollback triggers, and two trainer-led enablement sessions for ops and devs.

Key asks for Redwood team:
- Confirm proposed canary windows (timezone: PST) and required lead time for GPU staging.
- Define rollback protocol (who flips the switch / who owns monitoring/alerts).
- Share a draft MAP spreadsheet we can keep in sync.

We have procurement looped (Jared Kim) — he’s on copy for billing/SOW timing.

Attachments: none in this message; happy to hop on a short call if needed.

Regards,
Alicia Torres
Director of Platform Engineering
Graystone Health
[phone: (415) 555-0198]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alicia Torres <alicia.torres@graystone-health.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Sep 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps post-signature / MAP kickoff

Alicia — thanks and congrats on the close. Quick responses below and a proposed cadence.

Proposed canary windows (PST):
- Canary Prep & dry-runs: Oct 6 - Oct 9 (internal validation).
- Canary live (10% traffic): Oct 13 - Oct 24 (two weeks, with daily check-ins).
- Scale / full cutover: Oct 27 (after acceptance gate).

Rollback protocol (high level):
- Alerting ownership: Graystone on-call -> Redwood on-call (handshake).
- Automated fallback: immediate re-route to previous stable model + traffic cut to 0% via router within 15 minutes.
- Manual rollback: if performance regressions >5% or error rate >3% sustained for 10m.

I’ve looped Marissa (implementation lead) to surface the MAP spreadsheet and training schedule; Ben will scope the migration runbook and staging requirements. Vanessa will be our CS lead for acceptance gates and training RSVP.

Next step: Marissa, can you post the MAP sheet and a short sprint matrix into the shared Drive by EOD tomorrow? That will let Alicia & Jared sign off on the gates and SOW dates.

—Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Alicia Torres <alicia.torres@graystone-health.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Sep 2025 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: MAP draft + sprint matrix (GSH)

Hi all — attached is a first-pass MAP and sprint matrix. Highlights:

Attachments: GSH_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet) — tabs: Overview / SprintMatrix / CanaryChecks / TrainingPlan / RollbackProcedures

Sprint matrix (high level):
- Sprint 0 (pre-work): Sep 29 - Oct 3 — infra prep, network allowlist, baseline metrics capture.
- Sprint 1 (staging + dry-run): Oct 6 - Oct 10 — end-to-end test and KV cache warm-ups.
- Sprint 2 (canary): Oct 13 - Oct 24 — 10% traffic, daily acceptance checks; acceptance criteria enumerated in CanaryChecks tab.
- Sprint 3 (scale & monitor): Oct 27 - Nov 7 — staged ramp to 100% with burst capacity plan.

Training plan: two live sessions (ops + devs) scheduled Oct 8 and Oct 15, recorded and paired with runbook walkthroughs.

RollbackProcedures (summary):
- Automatic: prefix cache flush + traffic split revert triggered by alert threshold (Ben owns runbook).
- Manual: executive rollback call (Jonas leads), documented sign-off in the MAP sheet.

Open items for Graystone:
1) Confirm acceptance owners for each CanaryChecks row (who will validate model accuracy vs baseline).
2) Provide shadow traffic sample volumes for Oct 13 canary (est. 2k reqs/day).
3) Procurement: confirm SOW final date so we can lock training resource allocations.

I’ll update the Drive link when I publish v1.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: GSH_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Alicia Torres <alicia.torres@graystone-health.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jared Kim <jared.kim@graystone-health.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Sep 2025 10:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft + sprint matrix (GSH)

Marissa — I reviewed the MAP and it looks good. A few clarifications:
- Acceptance owners: I will own accuracy checks for model drift, Dr. Patel (Graystone Data Science) will own data integrity checks, and Jared will own procurement gating for SOW milestones.
- Shadow traffic: we can provide ~2,500 reqs/day for the first week of canary, then increase to 5k if all gates pass.

Procurement note: Jared confirmed he needs the final SOW and training dates by Sep 30 to authorize Oct invoices. I’ve attached the latest draft SOW with a single minor billing item to align resources.

On the rollback triggers: I want a concrete runbook step that includes the observable (metric + threshold), the immediate mitigations, and the owner who will execute manual rollback. Ben — can you expand the rollback tab to include runbook checkboxes for each step?

Thanks — will loop in Dr. Patel separately for acceptance validation.

Best,
Alicia

Team — bringing this thread to a short checklist for internal alignment before we publish MAP v1 to the shared Drive: 

Internal checklist (Redwood):
- Ben: expand RollbackProcedures tab with explicit runbook steps and checkboxes (due Sep 30 EOD).
- Marissa: publish v1 to Drive and add acceptance owner column (due Sep 30 EOD).
- Vanessa: prepare training invites + RSVP tracker and draft post-training survey (due Oct 3).
- Jonas: coordinate exec sign-off with Alicia & Jared once MAP is in Drive; confirm on-call handoff plan.

Customer asks captured: acceptance owners, shadow traffic volumes, SOW finalization. Once the Drive is updated and Jared confirms SOW, we are green to book training and start Sprint 0 on Sep 29.

If there are no objections I’ll mark this thread as the canonical source and post a short summary to the HubSpot deal record.

Thanks all — green on my side pending the v1 publish.
